description: Réseau cyclable - Saint-Hyacinthe is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Saint-Hyacinthe. Couche linéaire du réseau cyclable de la ville. Comprend les sentiers polyvalents, les bandes cyclables, le réseau sur rue, etc. Contexte de collecte Collecte manuelle par processus de mise à jour en collaboration avec les service du génie et le service des loisirs. Méthode de collecte Cartographie assistée par ordinateur. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Saint-Hyacinthe. It offers 2 resource(s) in ESRIREST, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2025-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
